Bug: on Windows the built CLI exited 0 without doing anything when input came on stdin (assignment close, intent create), because packages/runtime/src/cli/main.ts used Effect.runFork and a pending Bun.stdin.text() does not keep the process alive. Fix: top-level await Effect.runPromise; dispatch InvalidDraft refusal hints {"id": "<id>"}; regression test packages/runtime/tests/stdin.test.ts; rebuilt packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/holyagent.js.
Known Windows baseline: about 108 tests fail on untouched main on this machine (symlink EPERM, backslash paths, POSIX modes); compare against that.
constraints: Read-only: no edits, no version-control writes, nothing under .git/ or .holyagent/.
When the review is done, stop and report findings marked blocking or non-blocking with file:line; launch no other reviewers.
